docs.summary: Post-lowering optimizer. Takes the straight-lowered SPIR-V word stream and returns an optimized one, targeting byte-for-byte parity with spirv-opt's Performance pipeline (the level shaderc runs at `OptimizationLevel.Performance`). Phase 2 adds passes here one at a time, in spirv-opt's order. Until the pipeline reproduces every transformation for a given module, its optimized parity test stays red and marks what is left to do. The full, verified feature-gap list (front-end AND optimizer) lives in /GAPS.md at the repo root. Passes present here: StripDebug, DeadBranchElim, MergeReturn, Inline(=InlineExhaustive, O(n)), EliminateDeadFunctions, PrivateToLocal, LocalSingleBlockElim, LocalSingleStoreElim, ScalarReplacement, LocalAccessChainConvert, SsaRewrite(=LocalMultiStoreElim), GlobalCse(=RedundancyElimination), RedundantLoadElim, BlockMerge, RecomputeBound. ReciprocalFDiv and FoldInsertWithConstants are folding rules inside Simplification/Ccp. The dominant remaining blocker is NOT missing capability -- it is byte-parity: matching spirv-opt's exact scratch/throwaway id-allocation and fold ORDER. Nearly every remaining red is functionally correct + valid.
